hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); [[ "$FILE" == *.sql ]] && grep -qi 'CREATE TABLE' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -qi 'ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"WARNING: SQL file contains CREATE TABLE without ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Per project rules, ALL new Supabase tables must have RLS enabled and appropriate policies added before the migration is complete."}}' || true
